A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TCA research. Their complete main text, appendices, equations, tables and figures are readable and support reliable matching despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original CLIP adaptation results on cross-dataset and ImageNet distribution-shift benchmarks, alongside component ablations and token analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results and analyses across its main text and supplementary material.

M1.justification: The class-specific reservoir, cross-head pruning, coreset merging and logit correction procedures remain unchanged. Renaming anchors/CTR to domain <cls> tokens/DTR does not introduce a new component; Algorithm 1 retains the same steps.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same ten cross-dataset classification datasets, ImageNet and its four distribution-shift variants. The OOD evaluation moves from the main text to v2 Supplementary Section 5.1; coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches in every corresponding table. The comparison involving TDA combined with ATS, EViT and ToME also remains, moving from v1 Figure 4c to v2 Figure 6.

E3.justification: Both retain the same CLIP backbones, batch size of one, unaugmented TCA inference, K=2, condensation budgets, accuracy/GFLOPs metrics and ablation sweeps. No changed evaluation protocol is documented.

E4.justification: The preliminary token studies, component and hyperparameter ablations, budget analyses, condensation visualizations and OOD failure examples are retained. Moving the reservoir-size discussion into the main text and splitting Figure 4 do not add analyses.

E5.justification: The same point-estimate tables and shaded preliminary-study plots remain. Neither version adds run or seed counts, explanations of uncertainty bands, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All nine table bodies match after renumbering, and plotted results and qualitative examples are retained. TCA retains 68.69% cross-dataset average accuracy at R=0.9 and 59.57% OOD-only average accuracy at R=0.95.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Equations (1)-(12) are retained. Parts of the class-selection and ranking definitions move into prose without substantive mathematical revision. No assumptions, guarantees or proofs are added.

C1.justification: v2 narrows the abstract's superiority claim to cross-dataset CLIP tasks; v1 also included OOD adaptation and framed the method more broadly for VLMs. The central training-free condensation contribution and headline accuracy/efficiency magnitudes remain.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly contrasts possible in-domain accuracy degradation with condensation benefits on certain unseen datasets, qualifying the applicability of its motivating observation. Existing mechanism explanations and limitations concerning severe distribution shifts remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 newly states that source code is provided in supplementary material and removes the direct official-CLIP repository footnote. The project-code link and implementation settings remain unchanged. The supplied PDFs do not establish availability of the claimed supplementary code.

R1.justification: The same 70 cited works remain. However, v2 adds an explicit contrast with prior in-domain token-reduction tradeoffs and describes abstract-level novelty as the first approach for CLIP token efficiency, revising the earlier emphasis on token efficiency within TTA.

P1.justification: v2 retitles the paper, substantially rewrites the abstract and introductory framing, replaces anchors/CTR terminology throughout, creates a preliminary-studies subsection and reorganizes experiments between the main text and supplement.

P2.justification: The document changes from single-column to two-column layout, substantially reflowing tables, figures and Algorithm 1. Figure 2 panels become side by side, Figure 4c becomes supplementary Figure 6, the OOD table moves, and diagram labels and captions are revised.

improvement.justification: v2's narrower abstract claim better matches the unchanged OOD table, where TCA trails several baselines. Revised captions clarify existing plots. Although OOD evidence becomes less prominent, its results and limitations remain available. These are modest gains in claim calibration and presentation; experimental support and uncertainty reporting do not improve.
